ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 65/35 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity pixels form a primary mask covering the central peduncle and superior margins of both lobes; high-intensity pixels are localized in the distal-inferior quadrants, containing dense stochastic low-intensity mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal pixel angle of 40-45 degrees; vertical depth is significant relative to the horizontal span of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge boundary displays high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks <10 pixels) without major divots or amputations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Superior margins exhibit smooth convex curvature tapering to sharp lateral tips; inferior margins display a compound curve, starting concave near the notch and transitioning to convex at the mid-lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several discrete, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters (4-12 pixel diameter) are visible within the high-intensity regions of the right distal lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four distinct, vertically oriented parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) located on the ventral surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible parallel vertical linear tracks on the mid-distal section of the right lobe; minor irregular pixel disruptions at the trailing edge of the left lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular stochastic transition zone (salt-and-pepper effect) between the solid low-intensity central mass and the high-intensity distal areas.
